# temps_access_bundle (Resource)

A subset of a vault's services granted together for a limited time.

Import with `<vault_id>/<id>`.

Required API key permissions: `settings:read`, `settings:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_access_bundle" "read" {
  vault_id    = temps_access_vault.finance.id
  name        = "Read invoices"
  service_ids = [temps_access_service.billing_api.id]
  ttl_seconds = 900
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the bundle.
- `service_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the vault's services in the bundle.
- `ttl_seconds` (Number) How long a grant of the bundle lasts.
- `vault_id` (String) ID of the access vault.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `<vault_id>/<id>`.
- `version` (Number) Revision, raised by every change.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <vault_id>/<id>
terraform import temps_access_bundle.read vault_0123456789abcdef/bundle_0123456789abcdef
```
